idea-plugin.name: HaifaSSH - SSH Session Manager
idea-plugin.description:
HaifaSSH — SSH session manager for JetBrains IDEs

A MobaXterm-style SSH workflow built into the IDE:

  • Session tree — organize SSH sessions into folders in the SSH Sessions tool window.
  • Embedded terminals — double-click a session to open an interactive SSH shell as a tab in the SSH Terminals tool window.
  • Secure credentials — passwords and key passphrases are stored in the IDE Password Safe, never in plain-text config.
  • Key & jump-host auth — private-key authentication plus chained ProxyJump/bastion hosts.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• 0.6.0 — Security hardening. SSH host keys are now verified (trust-on-first-use against a managed known_hosts; changed keys warn and default to abort) — previously host-key checking was disabled. Weak legacy SHA-1/DSA algorithms are now opt-in per session (checkbox) instead of always on. Exports that include credentials are encrypted with a passphrase (AES-256) and written owner-only, instead of plaintext. In-memory connection secrets are passed as wipeable bytes. Note: connecting to a host for the first time now asks you to confirm its key, and old servers may need the new "Allow legacy SHA-1/DSA algorithms" checkbox.
  • 0.5.0 — Customize the session tree: pick a per-session icon and a color for sessions and folders (tints the icon and name). Rename any session or folder in place with Shift+F6. Type-to-search the tree to locate a session by name. Right-click for a context menu (Rename, Set Color…, Reset Color, Edit, Delete). Fixed the SSH Sessions tool-window icon showing dimmed/gray in the New UI.
  • 0.4.1 — Connect to older servers that only offer legacy SHA-1 host keys (re-enables ssh-rsa/ssh-dss as fallbacks), fixing "Algorithm negotiation fail: server_host_key ... serverProposal=ssh-rsa,ssh-dss".
  • 0.4.0 — Fixed the first lines of a new terminal rendering in white regardless of theme (the default cell style now follows the active scheme). Colored, non-gray session icon.
  • 0.3.0 — Terminal color schemes: ready-made templates (Classic Dark, Solarized, Monokai, One Dark, Light), "Follow IDE Theme", and a fully editable Custom scheme (background, foreground, selection, cursor, 16 ANSI colors) under Settings → Tools → HaifaSSH Terminal. Fixes washed-out dark colors and the black selection block.
  • 0.2.0 — Import/export sessions (optionally with credentials); open terminals as editor tabs (toggleable); terminals now follow the IDE dark/light theme.
  • 0.1.0 — Initial release: session tree, embedded SSH terminal, key & jump-host support.
